metadata.title: Guidelines for Listing Medicinal Products on the Provisionally Authorised Medicinal Products Register (Fiji MRA)
metadata.edition: March 2024 (1 March 2024 is a placeholder day) · 4(e)(ii) lifetime responsibility for quality, safety and efficacy; no adverse reaction reporting rule
metadata.legal_basis: Fiji Medicinal Products Board guideline under the Medicinal Products Decree 2011; the official text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.

candidates.statement: b) The Act [s29] requires that: “…no person shall import, manufacture, export, store, sell, distribute, transport, offer for sale, expose to sale or advertise any medicinal product which is not registered with the Fiji Medicinal Products Board…” c) The Act provides for the Fiji Medicinal Products Board (the Board) to list medicinal products on the Provisionally Authorised Medicinal Products Register.
candidates.context: 1. Purpose and Principles a) The Medicinal Products Act 2011 (the Act) & National Medicinal Products Policy 2013 apply to the regulation of medicinal products in Fiji. d) The Board has assigned to the Fiji MRA the functions of receiving, assessing, and referring applications for listing to the Board for decision, implementing the decisions of the Board, and supporting the Board to promote the objects of the Act.

candidates.statement: b) Each person must make an application to list each medicinal product they wish to deal with.
candidates.context: 2. Listing Medicinal Products on the Provisionally Authorised Medicinal Product Register a) The Board may list medicinal products upon receipt of information which is specified in a notification published in the Gazette. c) The Fiji MRA Online Services Portal is used by applicants and the Fiji MRA to apply for, receive, process, and record the listing of medicinal products in Fiji.

candidates.statement: i. The Portal is accessible from the Fiji MRA website at https://www.health.gov.fj/fiji-mra/ ii. All applicants are required to register an account on the Portal.
candidates.context: c) The Fiji MRA Online Services Portal is used by applicants and the Fiji MRA to apply for, receive, process, and record the listing of medicinal products in Fiji. iii. Instructions for using the Portal are available on the Fiji MRA website and from the Help menu within the Portal.

candidates.statement: d) An application to list a medicinal product must be approved by the Board before the applicant may deal with that medicinal product.
candidates.context: iv. All communication between applicants and the Fiji MRA is through the Portal or by email. e) The Board may list a medicinal product for a specified period of time.

candidates.statement: 3. Requirements for Applicants a) Applicants to list a medicinal product are required to:
candidates.context: j) The Fiji MRA reserves the right to require compliance with additional conditions when listing a medicinal product. i. Be registered by the FCCC and have a current valid license authorising them to deal with medicinal products in Fiji; and ii. Apply to the Fiji MRA to list each of the medicinal products they wish to deal with; and iii. Provide the required information about each medicinal product they wish to deal with.

candidates.statement: 4. Requirements for Medicinal Products a) Each application must include the required information about each medicinal product. This includes:
candidates.context: i. Be registered by the FCCC and have a current valid license authorising them to deal with medicinal products in Fiji; and ii. Apply to the Fiji MRA to list each of the medicinal products they wish to deal with; and iii. Provide the required information about each medicinal product they wish to deal with. i. Compulsory: i. Registration status in Australia or New Zealand. ii. Registration status in other countries.

candidates.statement: i. Applicants must confirm the accuracy of any pre-filled information before submitting an application.
candidates.context: iv. Product registration certificate(s) from other countries. b) Medicinal products registered in Australia or New Zealand will have some of this information pre- filled in the Portal for convenience. c) The Fiji MRA reserves the right to request additional information from applicants to support assessment of the application.

candidates.statement: e) Applicants must confirm and declare for each application that: i. All the information in the application and accompanying documentation is correct, complete, and true to the best of their knowledge.
candidates.context: d) The Fiji MRA reserves the right to request evidence of the provided information to support assessment of the application. ii. They take full responsibility on the quality, safety, and efficacy, of the listed medicinal product over its lifetime and will ensure that each individual batch imported complies with laws in force in Fiji. And, if required, that they will cooperate with any official of the Fiji Medicinal Products Board in performing an inspection.

candidates.statement: v. They acknowledge that if the required information requested by the Fiji Medicinal Products Board is not without valid reasons submitted the medicinal product shall be delisted from the provisionally authorised medicinal products register.
candidates.context: iv. They confirm and agree to furnish the Fiji Medicinal Products Regulatory Authority with registration information as required in respect to a provisionally authorised medicinal product within such time as is stipulated in the communication. vi. They confirm and agree that the Fiji Medicinal Products Board shall have the authority to suspend or cancel the provisional authorisation if the medicinal product is found not to have not complied with laws in force in Fiji.

candidates.context: v. They acknowledge that if the required information requested by the Fiji Medicinal Products Board is not without valid reasons submitted the medicinal product shall be delisted from the provisionally authorised medicinal products register. vii. They confirm and agree that the provisional authorisation is not transferable to another company without the written authorisation of the Fiji Medicinal Products Board.
